evidence.reason: The fixture still initializes a temporary repository, sets only user.email and user.name, and creates commits without disabling inherited `commit.gpgSign`. In an environment where global Git config enables commit signing and no usable signing key exists, the baseline commit at line 94 fails and `DeployTests.setUp()` errors; the later fixture commit is likewise vulnerable. This is an ordinary test-fixture correctness bug, not a new contract requirement. The smallest fix is repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit. The tip region shows no such setting, so the issue is not fixed.
